record.original_question: Let S be a numerical semigroup and let H(S) = N \ S be its set of gaps. Determine the genus g(S) = |H(S)| from a minimal system of generators of S when the embedding dimension e(S) is at least 3.

evidence.quote: Therefore the second problem consists in determining the cardinality of H(S), sometimes known as genus of S ([25]) or degree of singularity of S ([3]).
For semigroups with embedding dimension greater than or equal to three these problems remain open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A numerical semigroup is a subset $S \subseteq \mathbb{N} = \{0,1,2,\dots\}$ that is closed under addition, contains $0$, and has finite complement $H(S) = \mathbb{N} \setminus S$. Elements of $H(S)$ are called the gaps of $S$, and the genus of $S$ is $g(S) = |H(S)|$. Every numerical semigroup $S \neq \mathbb{N}$ admits a unique minimal system of generators $\{n_1 < n_2 < \cdots < n_e\}$, where $e = e(S)$ is the embedding dimension of $S$ (so $S = \{a_1 n_1 + \cdots + a_e n_e : a_i \in \mathbb{N}\}$ and $\gcd(n_1,\dots,n_e) = 1$).

Problem: Provide a closed-form expression (or algorithm of analogous explicit nature to the formulas known in the case $e(S) = 2$, where $g(S) = (n_1-1)(n_2-1)/2$) that, for every numerical semigroup $S$ with embedding dimension $e(S) \geq 3$, determines the genus $g(S)$ as a function of a minimal system of generators $\{n_1, \dots, n_e\}$ of $S$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of giving a general closed formula for the genus of a numerical semigroup in terms of its minimal generators when the embedding dimension is at least 3 is widely regarded as open. It has been shown that no polynomial formula can compute the Frobenius number or genus for embedding dimension 3 in general, although partial results exist for special classes (e.g., symmetric and pseudo-symmetric semigroups, and algorithmic procedures for the embedding dimension 3 case). For embedding dimension ≥ 4, the problem remains open in even stronger forms.

status_evidence.title: Numerical semigroup - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Closed formulas are known only in special cases; the general embedding dimension ≥ 3 case lacks a closed formula.
status_evidence.claim: No general closed formula is known for the genus when embedding dimension is at least 3.

status_evidence.title: The Frobenius problem for numerical semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: It is shown that no polynomial formula exists for the Frobenius number/genus in embedding dimension 3.
status_evidence.claim: For embedding dimension three, no polynomial formula computes the genus, supporting that an explicit closed expression is not available.
